components.name: Icon
components.summary: Inline stroke icons on a 24px grid, drawn at 1.75px with round caps, for controls and map markers.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A text button in five variants and three sizes; renders an a when href is given.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A square icon-only button with a required accessible name.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labelled text input or textarea with hint and error text.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: The floating search combobox that finds a river or stream by name.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A native select with the Headwaters field styling.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox for independent options and Radio for one-of-many, with 22px targets and a 44px row.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A switch for settings that take effect immediately.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A range input with a visible label and value readout in mono.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A radio-group segmented toggle for two to four exclusive choices.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tabs with roving focus and arrow-key navigation, for panels that hold two to four views.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: A breadcrumb trail for the place hierarchy of the atlas.

components.name: Masthead
components.summary: The site header with the Headwaters wordmark set in plain serif type and the ki uta ki tai subtitle.

components.name: MapControls
components.summary: A vertical group of map buttons for zoom, reset north, locate, layers and the 3D toggle.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: An inline message with an icon, a short title and a sentence of detail.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short confirmation that appears above the map and goes away by itself.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short text label that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A compact label for status or category.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A pulsing placeholder block for text while data loads.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: A loading state where a branching river network draws itself, with a plain-language message.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: An empty panel with faint contour lines, a title, one sentence and a next step.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog over a scrim for confirmations that need a decision.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: A bottom sheet that holds the river panel on mobile, with three heights: peek, half and full.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A bordered surface for a single idea, with optional eyebrow, title, footer and contour background.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A labelled measurement: serif figure, mono unit, optional hint.

components.name: DefinitionList
components.summary: A two-column list of terms and plain-language details.

components.name: Table
components.summary: A compact table with right-aligned mono numerals.

components.name: Disclosure
components.summary: An expandable section built on the native details element.

components.name: Legend
components.summary: The map key.

components.name: Marker
components.summary: Map markers with different shapes: a ringed circle for a source, a diamond for a destination and a crosshair for the selected point.

components.name: ElevationProfile
components.summary: A compact elevation profile from source to mouth, drawn as SVG with a labelled start and end.

components.name: PlaceName
components.summary: A place name that shows official Māori and English names together, with the right language tag on each.

components.name: CoordinateLabel
components.summary: A small mono coordinate label, with an optional grid-red leader line in the manner of Topo50 annotations.

components.name: RiverPanel
components.summary: The floating panel that shows the selected river: name, summary, length, catchment area, source, destination and the three main actions.

components.name: TributaryList
components.summary: A list of tributaries with a checkbox to show each on the map and its length.

components.name: JourneyBar
components.summary: A compact source-to-sea strip showing the stage of the river, with elevation and distance at each.

components.name: ScaleBar
components.summary: A map scale bar in kilometres.

components.name: Contours
components.summary: A procedural set of contour lines for introductions, cards and empty states.

components.name: RiverMotif
components.summary: A procedural branching river illustration for section dividers, empty states and loading.

components.name: Attribution
components.summary: A small attribution line for the map.
